exposure: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) treatment (Venoarterial ECMO, Venovenous ECMO)
cohort: Five critically ill pregnant women or parturients (mean age 30.2 years) treated with ECMO for respiratory and circulatory failure.
finding: ECMO technology can be used to treat some critical obstetric patients with respiratory and circulatory failure unresponsive to conventional treatment, leading to improved ventilation and oxygenation, but it does not affect the primary disease.
followup_time: Up to 10 months post-delivery for one patient (others had shorter follow-up or died sooner).
